authority: Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto (TSV) — Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman

decisions.description: TSV enforcement decisions: päätökset, seuraamusmaksut (fines), and huomautukset (reprimands)
decisions.notes: Covers decisions since GDPR entered into force (25 May 2018). Earlier decisions under the Personal Data Act (Henkilötietolaki 523/1999) are not included.
known_gaps: Pre-GDPR decisions under Henkilötietolaki 523/1999 are excluded
Pending/draft decisions not yet published on tietosuoja.fi are not included
Full text may be redacted for third-party privacy where TSV has published only summaries

guidelines.description: TSV guidance documents: ohjeet (guidelines), suositukset (recommendations), kannanotot (statements), and FAQ documents
guidelines.notes: Covers guidance published since GDPR implementation. Includes Finnish-language documents; some documents may also be available in Swedish or English.
known_gaps: EDPB guidelines referenced but not co-published by TSV are not duplicated here — use the EDPB MCP for those
Archived pre-GDPR guidance under the old DPA (Tietosuojalautakunta) is not included

topics.description: Controlled vocabulary for data protection topics covered by the corpus

completeness_notes: This corpus is an ongoing extraction from tietosuoja.fi. Completeness varies by year; older decisions may be under-represented. Run fi_dp_check_data_freshness for current row counts.
